name: gate_finding_in_untouched_file
about: The model reports the broken caller in checkout.py, which is not in the diff. The quote is real (the caller is in the context bundle) but the location is not placeable, so it is dropped as a bad location. A finding has to sit on the change that caused it.
diff:
diff --git a/invoice.py b/invoice.py
--- a/invoice.py
+++ b/invoice.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
-def calculate_discount(price):
-    return price * 0.9
+def calculate_discount(price, promos):
+    rate = 1 - sum(p.rate for p in promos)
+    return price * rate
